svg.title: F18-1 FWS circuit of one MSC-1 hall: P&ID with the commissioning test points
svg.text: P-1 shown; P-2 and P-3 in parallel, 2 duty + 1 standby
sterile sample bottles, cool box 2 to 8 °C
F18-1 FWS circuit of one MSC-1 hall: P&ID with the commissioning test points

hall B2-DH1 · 9.6 MW liquid load · FWS 35 °C supply, 45 °C return, 232 L/s · dry cooler leaves 41 °C at 34 °C dry-bulb (approach 7 K) · trim chiller 41 → 35 °C · 3 × 50 % pumps 116 L/s at 32 m · 16 CDUs of 1 MW, 24.2 L/s each

• Each test in chapter 18 has a test point: TP-1 and TP-2 for the pump curve, TP-3 for flow, TP-4 and TP-5 for the chiller capacity check, TP-6 and TP-7 for the dry-cooler check, SP-1 and SP-2 for water samples.
• The trim chiller carries 41 → 35 °C (6 K of the 10 K range) and the dry cooler 45 → 41 °C at design ambient: 60 % and 40 % of the range.
instrument bubble (ISA 5.1): letters = measured variable + function
